title: 🔥 God is Speaking – But Are You Listening? The Cost of Choosing Your Own Way!
paragraphs: 🔥 God is Speaking – But Are You Listening? The Cost of Choosing Your Own Way!

"Have you ever asked God for guidance, but then ignored what He told you? Have you ever read the Bible, but then chosen to do what felt easier or more comfortable instead? Many people pray for direction, but when God speaks, they refuse to follow Him!"

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, does God still guide people today? And what happens if I keep ignoring Him?"

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE – James 1:22 (KJV):
"But be ye doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving your own selves."

🚨 THE TRUTH: What This Blog Will Reveal!
✔️ Why many people ignore God’s voice and choose what feels comfortable.
✔️ Biblical examples of people who suffered for rejecting God's guidance.
✔️ The dangers of selective obedience—only following God when it’s easy.
✔️ How to fully surrender and follow God’s will in every area of life!

WHY DO PEOPLE IGNORE GOD’S GUIDANCE?
Many believers claim they want to follow God, but when His instructions become uncomfortable, they choose their own way. This section exposes the common reasons why people reject God's guidance.

🔥 1. BECAUSE IT’S EASIER TO DO WHAT YOU WANT!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, why do people ignore God’s commands even when they know what’s right?"

📖 Matthew 7:13-14 (KJV):
"Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat: Because strait is the gate, and narrow is the way, which leadeth unto life, and few there be that find it."
💡 THE TRUTH:

The path to destruction is WIDE because it is easier and more comfortable.
The path to life is NARROW because it requires surrender, obedience, and faith.
🚨 THE WARNING: If we choose what is easy instead of what is right, we are walking toward destruction!

🔥 2. BECAUSE OF FEAR AND DOUBT!
📖 Proverbs 3:5-6 (KJV):
"Trust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding. In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths."
💡 THE TRUTH:

Many people ignore God’s commands because they are afraid to trust Him fully.
They believe their own wisdom is better than God’s, so they choose their own way.
🚨 THE WARNING: Doubting God leads to disobedience! We must trust His wisdom over our feelings.

🔥 3. BECAUSE THEY ONLY WANT TO FOLLOW GOD WHEN IT’S CONVENIENT!
📖 Luke 6:46 (KJV):
"And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?"
💡 THE TRUTH:

Many people only obey God when it benefits them.
They want blessings without obedience.
They reject correction and only follow what is comfortable.
🚨 THE WARNING: Partial obedience is disobedience! God is not looking for people who follow Him when it’s easy—He wants full surrender.

BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF PEOPLE WHO IGNORED GOD AND SUFFERED!
This section highlights real biblical stories of people who chose their own way instead of God's will—and faced serious consequences.

🔥 KING SAUL – HE REJECTED GOD’S INSTRUCTIONS AND LOST EVERYTHING!
📖 1 Samuel 15:22-23 (KJV):
"Behold, to obey is better than sacrifice, and to hearken than the fat of rams. For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry. Because thou hast rejected the word of the Lord, he hath also rejected thee from being king."
💡 THE LESSON FROM SAUL:

God commanded Saul to destroy the Amalekites completely.
But Saul disobeyed and kept what he wanted.
As a result, God rejected him as king!
🚨 THE WARNING: Selective obedience is still rebellion! If we only follow God when we agree with Him, we are not truly obeying Him.

🔥 JONAH – HE TRIED TO ESCAPE GOD’S CALLING AND FACED A STORM!
📖 Jonah 1:3-4 (KJV):
"But Jonah rose up to flee unto Tarshish from the presence of the Lord... But the Lord sent out a great wind into the sea, and there was a mighty tempest in the sea."
💡 THE LESSON FROM JONAH:

God told Jonah to preach in Nineveh, but he ran the other way.
Because of his disobedience, a great storm came!
Jonah was thrown into the sea and swallowed by a great fish.
🚨 THE WARNING: Running from God’s will only brings trouble. When we ignore God’s calling, we invite storms into our lives!

🔥 LOT’S WIFE – SHE LOOKED BACK AND TURNED INTO A PILLAR OF SALT!
📖 Genesis 19:26 (KJV):
"But his wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt."
💡 THE LESSON FROM LOT'S WIFE:

God commanded Lot’s family to flee Sodom and not look back.
But Lot’s wife couldn’t let go of her past.
As a result, she was judged instantly!
🚨 THE WARNING: If we hold onto our old ways instead of fully obeying God, we will face serious consequences.

HOW TO STOP IGNORING GOD AND FOLLOW HIS GUIDANCE!
Now that we’ve seen the dangers of ignoring God, this section teaches how to surrender fully to His will.
💡 5 WAYS TO FOLLOW GOD COMPLETELY:

✔ 1️⃣ Read the Bible and Do What It Says (James 1:22-25)
✔ 2️⃣ Trust God Even When It’s Hard (Proverbs 3:5-6)
✔ 3️⃣ Stop Making Excuses for Sin (Romans 6:1-2)
✔ 4️⃣ Surround Yourself with Obedient Believers (Hebrews 10:25)
✔ 5️⃣ Pray for Strength to Obey (Psalm 51:10)
🚨 THE TRUTH: God does not give His Word for us to ignore it. We must follow Him even when it’s uncomfortable!

PROOF & EVIDENCE – HISTORICAL AND DOCUMENTED SOURCES!
Many skeptics deny the consequences of ignoring God’s guidance, claiming that they can live however they want without any consequences. However, history, archaeology, and real-life testimonies confirm that rejecting God’s Word leads to destruction!

🔥 PROOF #1: HISTORICAL EVENTS THAT PROVE IGNORING GOD LEADS TO DISASTER!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, are there historical examples of nations or people suffering because they ignored God?"
✔ YES! Many powerful nations that rejected God have fallen!
🔥 THE FALL OF ISRAEL & JUDAH – DESTROYED BECAUSE OF DISOBEDIENCE!

The northern kingdom of Israel ignored God’s warnings and worshiped idols.
Because of their disobedience, God allowed the Assyrians to invade and destroy them (722 B.C.).
Later, the southern kingdom of Judah also rejected God’s commands, and the Babylonians conquered them (586 B.C.).
📖 2 Kings 17:18 (KJV):
"Therefore the Lord was very angry with Israel, and removed them out of his sight: there was none left but the tribe of Judah only."
🚨 THE LESSON: Nations that reject God’s Word eventually fall!

🔥 PROOF #2: THE RUINS OF SODOM & GOMORRAH – PHYSICAL EVIDENCE OF GOD’S JUDGMENT!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, is there scientific proof that Sodom and Gomorrah were really destroyed?"
✔ YES! Archaeologists have discovered sulfur balls and scorched ruins in the exact location of Sodom and Gomorrah!

📖 Genesis 19:24 (KJV):
"Then the Lord rained upon Sodom and upon Gomorrah brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven."
🔬 EVIDENCE:

Excavations at Tall el-Hammam (believed to be ancient Sodom) show signs of extreme heat and sudden destruction.
Scientists have found pure sulfur balls embedded in the ruins, which match the biblical description of brimstone.
🔗 Scientific Evidence of Sodom’s Destruction:
👉 https://www.icr.org/article/science-sodom-gomorrah
🚨 THE LESSON: The Bible is NOT a myth—God’s judgment is real!

GREEK & HEBREW WORD ANALYSIS – DEEPER BIBLICAL REVELATION!
Many people misunderstand obedience to God because they do not study the original biblical languages. This section breaks down the Greek and Hebrew words for obedience and rebellion.

🔥 GREEK WORD ANALYSIS – "OBEDIENCE" (Ὑπακοή – Hypakoē)
📖 Romans 6:16 (KJV):
"Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey (hypakoē), his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?"
💡 Meaning in Greek:

Hypakoē means "to listen attentively and submit to authority."
Biblical obedience is not just hearing—it’s following through with action.
🚨 THE LESSON: Many people hear God’s Word but never apply it. True faith requires action!

🔥 HEBREW WORD ANALYSIS – "REBELLION" (מְרִי – Meri)
📖 Ezekiel 2:8 (KJV):
"But thou, son of man, hear what I say unto thee; Be not thou rebellious (meri) like that rebellious house."
💡 Meaning in Hebrew:

Meri means "to be stubborn, defiant, and resistant to authority."
In the Old Testament, rebellion was considered as serious as witchcraft!
📖 1 Samuel 15:23 (KJV):
"For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry."
🚨 THE LESSON: If we constantly ignore God, we are walking in rebellion.

🔥 TESTIMONY: "I IGNORED GOD'S WARNING – AND LOST EVERYTHING!"
"I was a believer, but I didn’t like the idea of surrendering FULLY to God. I would read the Bible, but only follow the parts that felt comfortable. I knew deep down that God was calling me to let go of certain things—unhealthy relationships, bad habits, selfish desires—but I kept making excuses. I told myself, ‘God understands, He knows my heart.’"

"One day, I felt strongly that God was telling me to stop a business deal that seemed promising but was built on lies. But I ignored His warning. I told myself that God would bless me anyway. At first, everything seemed fine. But suddenly, things took a turn for the worse. The deal fell apart, I lost a huge amount of money, and worst of all, my reputation was damaged. I realized that God had been protecting me all along, but I was too stubborn to listen."

"In my brokenness, I cried out to God. I repented and asked for His forgiveness. And in His mercy, He restored me—not financially at first, but spiritually. He showed me that true success comes from obedience, not shortcuts. Now, I live differently. I don’t just read the Bible—I obey it. And I’ve learned that when God speaks, ignoring Him is NEVER worth it!"

🔥 MAKE A STAND – REPEAT THIS DECLARATION OUT LOUD!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, I don’t want to ignore God anymore. How do I fully surrender?"
⚔ 🔥 GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION – REPEAT OUT LOUD! 🔥

"Lord Jesus, I surrender my will to You. I reject every excuse, every fear, and every distraction that keeps me from fully obeying Your Word. No more picking and choosing—I will follow You completely! Help me trust You even when it’s hard, and give me the strength to walk in Your perfect will. I declare that I am no longer my own—I belong to You! In Jesus' mighty name, AMEN!"

🔥 TAKE ACTION NOW – DON’T JUST READ, APPLY IT!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, what should I do next to stay obedient to God?"
💡 HERE'S WHAT YOU CAN DO RIGHT NOW:

Help others break free from selective obedience!
